pages.title: Totem Wrench
text: Every machine in the camp faces somewhere, and sooner or later it faces the wrong way. Use the wrench on a block and it turns, without breaking and replacing it.
**Sneak-use a machine's face** and that face steps through Both, Input, Output and Closed — the same setting the machine's own side pad shows, reachable from outside the screen.

pages.title: What it costs
text: A turn takes **1 Pulse** from any cell you carry. With no Pulse on you the wrench wears a point of its **512** instead, so it still works on a bad day.
It refuses blocks that cannot turn, and it refuses another tribe's machines, same as an empty hand would.

pages.title: Weaver's Wand
text: Click the face of a block and the wand carries that face outward across every neighbour like it: up to **32 blocks** in one sweep.
The blocks come from your pack and cost **2 Pulse** each. It only fills open air, never replacing anything that is already there, so a floor is laid in a click and nothing underneath is lost.
